overview:
Lynk is an expert network founded in 2015. In a GPCA interview, Peggy Choi identified Evan Xiao Han and Jennifer Li as fellow founders and described her prior work at Silver Lake and TPG.

Lynk currently presents itself as a consulting and market research solution, offering expert interviews, surveys and project support. Its website reports 800,000+ experts, consultants and talents. It combines a Client Solutions team with independent consultants and industry specialists, offering unbundled services or full-project engagements.

In September 2021, Lynk announced that investment from UBS brought total funding to $35 million. This is a historical funding figure, not a current valuation or funding total.

history.narrative:
Founded in 2015, Lynk developed its Knowledge-as-a-Service platform to connect companies with specialist expertise. Funding included a $1 million seed round in 2015 and a $4 million Series A in 2017, according to Global Venturing. Its November 2019 announcement named MassMutual Ventures Southeast Asia, Alibaba Entrepreneurs Fund and Wavemaker Partners but did not disclose an amount.

Lynk announced $24 million in funding in January 2021, led by Brewer Lane Ventures and MassMutual Ventures with Alibaba Entrepreneurs Fund participating. UBS invested later that year; the September announcement reported $35 million raised to date.

timeline.event: Founded by Peggy Choi with Evan Xiao Han and Jennifer Li; raised a $1 million seed round led by Wavemaker Partners.

Announced $24 million in funding led by Brewer Lane Ventures and MassMutual Ventures, with Alibaba Entrepreneurs Fund participating.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Consultations
servicesDetailed.description: Lynk offers expert interviews and consultations, supported by its Client Solutions team and network of specialists.

servicesDetailed.name: Survey Services
servicesDetailed.description: Lynk offers custom surveys and reports access to 6.3 million B2B and B2C survey panelists.

servicesDetailed.name: Consulting and Market Research
servicesDetailed.description: Lynk advertises market entry research, competitor and customer insights, product research, due diligence and digital transformation support.

servicesDetailed.name: Automation Services
servicesDetailed.description: Lynk advertises AI-assisted data extraction, document generation and lead generation automation.

aiPlatform.narrative: Lynk says it uses AI for expert matching and workflow automation. Its current automation offering also includes document generation, data extraction and lead generation. These are provider descriptions; performance was not independently tested.

complianceExtended.narrative: Lynk describes a customizable compliance framework for enterprise consultations. These controls are company-stated rather than an independent assessment of their effectiveness.
highlights: Lynk says expert interactions are stored and linked to expert profiles for monitoring and audits
Company-described background verification and reference checks
Mandatory training at joining and annually thereafter, according to Lynk
Rules against current-employer consultations and sharing MNPI
Customizable selection rules and a company Do Not Call List

clientFit.narrative: Editorial assessment: the advertised mix of interviews, surveys and consulting projects may suit buyers who want research and implementation support from one provider. Buyers should confirm current specialist availability, delivery format and commercial terms.

strengths: Lynk reports 800,000+ experts, consultants and talents
Company-described support from a Client Solutions team and independent consultants
Offers both unbundled services and full-project engagements
caveats: Network scale and AI capabilities are company-stated
The 200+ employee figure dates to January 2021; current staffing was not verified
Current pricing and subscription terms require confirmation with Lynk
Current headquarters was not established from the sources reviewed; the contact page lists team locations without identifying a headquarters
notableFacts: Peggy Choi described her Silver Lake and TPG background in a GPCA interview
Lynk reported $35 million in total funding in September 2021
The 2021 UBS collaboration included access to UBS research analysts through Lynk
